processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests from calling backends and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The server that runs the actual model on GPU nodes, loads model artifacts, and reads customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features such as account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network. ... The features include account age and spend bands per customer.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts that may contain user-typed content.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery

data_flows.name: inference requests
data_flows.description: Calling backends send inference requests to the gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
data_flows.data_description: Inference requests, including API keys in headers and potentially user-entered prompt content.

data_flows.name: forwarded requests
data_flows.description: The gateway forwards inference requests to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server
data_flows.notes: There is no authentication between the gateway and the model server.
data_flows.data_description: Inference requests forwarded for model processing.

data_flows.name: model artifact loads
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup
data_flows.notes: The model server uses its own service account for access. The source says artifact integrity is not believed to be verified: 'I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket.'

data_flows.name: customer feature reads
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network
data_flows.notes: Redis has no password on it.
data_flows.data_description: Customer features including account age and spend bands per customer.

data_flows.name: writes inference log
data_flows.description: The gateway writes every request and response to the BigQuery inference log for debugging.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging
data_flows.notes: The logged data includes raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.
data_flows.data_description: Every request and response, including raw prompts.

data_flows.name: artifact publication
data_flows.description: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket
data_flows.notes: The source is uncertain about governance of who can push and says, 'I think it is a shared group account.'

assumptions.basis: FastAPI is a web application framework and the text calls the component a service receiving requests.
